# Yale School of Medicine

> Yale School of Medicine is a leading academic medical institution offering comprehensive medical education, conducting NIH-funded research, and providing clinical training across multiple specialties under the leadership of Dean Nancy J. Brown.

Yale School of Medicine serves as a premier center for medical education, research innovation, and clinical practice, featuring the distinctive Yale System of Medical Education and extensive residency and fellowship programs. The institution maintains strong connections to Yale University and Yale Medicine's clinical operations.

- [Medical Education](https://medicine.yale.edu/edu): Medical education programs including MD, MD/PhD, PA, and residency/fellowship
- [Residency & Fellowship Programs](https://medicine.yale.edu/edu/residency-fellowships): Residency and fellowship training programs across specialties at Yale
- [Advance Your Career at Yale](https://medicine.yale.edu/faculty): Faculty career advancement and mentorship resources at Yale School of Medicine

- [Leadership, Administration & Governance](https://medicine.yale.edu/about/leadership-administration): YSM leadership structure and governance under Dean Nancy J. Brown

- [Yale School of Medicine Administration](https://medicine.yale.edu/about/leadership-administration/ysm-administration): YSM administrative staff directory and organizational structure

- [Committees, Searches, and Working Groups](https://medicine.yale.edu/about/leadership-administration/committees): YSM governance committees including Executive Group and Faculty Advisory
